items.hook: Boston Jenkins Drayton (1821–1864) was a Liberian politician and Lutheran minister who served as the 3rd Chief Justice of Liberia from 1861 until 1864.
items.body: He had previously served as the final Governor of the Republic of Maryland from 1855 until its annexation by Liberia on March 18, 1857. One of those things you can't un-know.

items.body: The Askey–Wilson polynomials are on the top level of the Askey scheme, which organizes orthogonal polynomials of hypergeometric type into a hierarchy. Bring it up somewhere. Watch the reaction.
